question: What is the set of ecosystem called?
solution:
The correct answer is Biome.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **biome** is the overall region of an **ecosystem**.
 
• A community of **plants and animals** that exist naturally in a place is referred to as a **biome**.
 
• These species share regional traits that are unique to that location.
 
• A **biome** is the** general ecological community**.
 
• There are three **types** of **biomes**: **marine, freshwater, and terrestrial.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stratosphere**

 
 
• ​ The** second layer of the Earth's atmosphere**, the **stratosphere**, is situated below the mesosphere and above the **troposphere**. The **stratosphere** is a layer of the **atmosphere** made up of stratified **temperature layers**, with warm layers of air high in the sky and cool layers of air low in the sky, not far from the **Earth's surface**.
 
 
 
• **Hydrosphere**
 
 
• The total mass of water present on, beneath, and above the surface of a planet, minor planet, or **natural satellite** is known as the **hydrosphere**. The **hydrosphere** on **Earth** has been present for nearly 4 billion years, yet it is still evolving.
 
 
 
• **Atmosphere**
 
 
• **A layer** (or layers) of gases that surround a planet and are held in place by the gravity of the** planetary body** is known as an **atmosphere**. When **gravity** is strong and the **temperature** of the **atmosphere is low,** a planet preserves its **atmosphere**.
